Neeraj Chopra and Gopichand Launch Coaching School

Olympic gold medalist Neeraj Chopra and badminton coach Pullela Gopichand have jointly launched the Indian School of Coaching Excellence. The initiative aims to foster coaching talent within India. The launch event was reported by multiple outlets.
